model.analytics_copilot.mart_customers.name: mart_customers
model.analytics_copilot.mart_customers.description: AI layer mart for customer lifecycle and LTV questions. One row per customer_id (person). Segment label is pre-computed so AI can filter directly with WHERE customer_segment = 'loyal'.

customer_state.name: customer_state
customer_state.description: State from the customer's most recent order. Filter dimension.

total_orders.name: total_orders
total_orders.description: Total number of distinct orders placed by this customer.

total_revenue.name: total_revenue
total_revenue.description: Sum of total_revenue across all orders (BRL). Customer lifetime value.

customer_segment.name: customer_segment
customer_segment.description: Segment label. Values: new (1 order), returning (2–3 orders), loyal (4+ orders). Filter dimension.

model.analytics_copilot.mart_orders.name: mart_orders
model.analytics_copilot.mart_orders.description: AI layer mart for order-level questions. One row per order_id.

order_year.name: order_year
order_year.description: Year extracted from order_date. Filter dimension.

model.analytics_copilot.stg__customers.name: stg__customers
model.analytics_copilot.stg__customers.description: Staging model — not an AI mart.
